boundary: All local numeric experiments are synthetic or hybrid proxies; Judge0 is independent runtime replication of one constructed mechanism, not live FRANK evidence.

experiments.interpretation: Persistent activation can retain support for relations revoked in newer semantic epochs. Epoch validation eliminates stale IDs in this construction but pays filter/rebase cost.
experiments.falsifier_next: Real ClayGraph/FRANK activation trace with semantic revocations and mixed-epoch instrumentation.

experiments.interpretation: Pairwise expansion can turn n-ary information loss into false associative activation; role-aware same-instance matching avoids the constructed mixing error.
experiments.falsifier_next: Randomized-order target-4B and live ClayGraph activation tests.

experiments.interpretation: Expected reads before next update materially affect the amortized crossover; a simple online estimator approached the hindsight oracle in this constructed nonstationary workload.
experiments.falsifier_next: Actual current-corpus read/write trace with controller overhead and crash/recovery costs.

experiments.interpretation: The deliberately sparse arm resists diffusion into the full graph in this planted workload. This validates only the control mechanism; top-400 is not an optimized cognitive policy.
experiments.falsifier_next: Ablate decay/inhibition/saturation/budget separately on real memory tasks and measure retrieval quality plus noise/cost.
